legend: Celi and Itzel decided to start their fitness journey. They bought matching outfits and trendy water bottles, but couldn't afford a personal trainer, so they turned to TikTok. There they found Coach Emily, whose main training philosophy is: "The gym isn't about how much weight you lift, but about the aura you radiate".
There are $$$N$$$ different exercises, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$N$$$.
On each of the $$$Z$$$ training days, Celi and Itzel can choose to perform exactly one exercise or take a rest day.
If they choose to perform exercise $$$i$$$ on day $$$c$$$ of a consecutive streak of that same exercise:   If $$$c \le d_i$$$: they gain $$$+k_i$$$ aura points.
If $$$c  \gt  d_i$$$: they gain $$$+(k_i - x_i)$$$ aura points (the penalty $$$x_i$$$ applies for each consecutive day that exceeds the optimal limit $$$d_i$$$).
If they choose to rest, they gain $$$0$$$ aura points and any active streak is reset to $$$0$$$.
If they switch from exercise $$$i$$$ to a different exercise $$$j \ne i$$$, the streak for exercise $$$j$$$ starts at $$$1$$$.

Initially (before day 1), they have no active streak. Celi and Itzel want to know the maximum amount of aura points they can accumulate by the end of the $$$Z$$$ training days if they choose their daily activities optimally.
input: The first line contains two integers $$$N$$$ and $$$Z$$$ ($$$1 \le N \le 1000$$$, $$$1 \le Z \le 1000$$$), the number of available exercises and the total number of training days.

The following $$$N$$$ lines describe the exercises. The $$$i$$$-th line contains three integers $$$k_i$$$, $$$d_i$$$, and $$$x_i$$$ ($$$1 \le k_i \le 10^9$$$, $$$1 \le d_i \le 100$$$, $$$0 \le x_i \le 10^9$$$), representing the base aura points per day, the optimal consecutive days threshold, and the penalty per additional consecutive day, respectively.
output: Print a single integer: the maximum amount of aura points that Celi and Itzel can accumulate over the $$$Z$$$ training days.
